title: Functional Scaling Limits of Interpolated Correlated Random Walks in Hölder Topology
summary: We prove functional scaling limits for interpolated random walks whose increments are functions of a stationary Gaussian sequence. In this setting, the classical Dobrushin-Major-Taqqu theorem describes the scaling limit when the covariance has a regularly varying, non-summable tail, while the Breuer-Major theorem describes the limit in the summable regime. We strengthen these convergence results to functional convergence in Hölder topology and, in the summable regime, in rough Hölder topology.
